messages:
DinoBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: rate_limit_service high 429 surge in us-east-1. 5xx low but 429s spiking. Incident page: https://infra.redwood/incident/2172501234
Emma: I'm on it. seeing customers get 429s on /v1/generate. initial spike ~02:03 UTC.
Liam: any deploys in last 10m? pinging release team.
Carlos: pushed rollout id=deploy-2026-03-15-0887 at 02:00 UTC — included a routing tweak and rlv2 flag enabled by default. not a canary, global rollout.
Emma: that matches. checking config — looks like exemptions list didn't ship with rl_v2. seeing token-accounting mismatch in logs.
Emma: running: ```
kubectl get deploy release-deploy-2026-03-15-0887 -o yaml
# output truncated
spec.template.spec.containers[0].env:
  - name: RLV2_ENABLED
    value: "true"
  - name: RLV2_EXEMPTIONS_PATH
    value: "/etc/rlv2/exemptions.json"
``` 
Carlos: that file was empty in the container image — builds pipeline bug. we shipped with an empty exemptions blob -> many internal/VIP tokens treated as subject to strict quotas.
Sofia: paging rotation — I'm taking lead, Emma handing off. Sofia here (prodops).
Emma: handing to Sofia. key facts: global rollout at 02:00, 429 surge start ~02:03, affected: token-accounting lookup failing -> exemptions not applied -> VIP customers hit hard.
Sofia: action plan: 1) flip kill-switch flag to disable rlv2 2) rollback deployment if flag flip not fast enough 3) apply temporary allowlist for affected accounts 4) notify support + customers.
Liam: try quick flag flip first. query feature flag service:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"key":"rlv2_enabled","value":false}'
```
DinoBot: Feature flag rl_v2 change request submitted by Liam. Change id: FF-2172501234-cmd.
Liam: response: 200 OK. verifying traffic...
Emma: traffic improving in us-east-1 — 429 rate down ~80% in 5m :white_check_mark: 
Maya: support here — opening priority tickets for top 10 accounts. copying CX templates.
Ivan: running quick rollback just in case:
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/release-deploy-2026-03-15-0887 --namespace=prod
```
Ivan: rollback started, pods terminating and old replica set coming up.
Sofia: both mitigations applied. monitoring for residual 429s and token miscounts.
DinoBot: Incident severity escalated -> Sev2 (impacting customers). PagerDuty notification updated.
Sofia: quick impact numbers: ~120 orgs had degraded calls in first 10m, ~18 orgs saw >10% failed requests. estimated user-facing errors ~2.4k requests. No long-lived data loss.
Maya: sending initial customer comms now. template: "We've detected an increased rate of 429s due to a rollout; mitigation in progress, we'll follow up with postmortem." 
Carlos: root cause summary: release pipeline omitted exemptions blob in container image for rlv2 feature. when rl_v2 landed globally, token accounting treated VIP tokens as non-exempt -> over-throttle.
Emma: follow-ups: fix pipeline to ensure exemptions are baked into image, add pre-release canary check for exemptions presence, add alert on sudden spike in 429s tied to feature flag flips.
Sofia: handoff: Emma back to normal duties, I (Sofia) am owning the incident until postmortem. Goals: customer outreach, mitigation verification, postmortem doc.
Maya: support noted 3 escalations to CSMs. prioritizing callbacks. 
Liam: temp mitigation validated across regions. we will keep rlv2 disabled until we have verified exemptions file and a staged rollout path.
Sofia: timeline notes: 02:00 UTC deploy -> 02:03 UTC spike -> 02:07 UTC flag flip -> 02:12 UTC rollback started -> 02:28 UTC traffic normalized.
DinoBot: Incident update posted to #incidents timeline. Incident commander: Sofia. Actions: postmortem + remediation by EOD.
Emma: thanks all, I'll own the pipeline fix with Carlos and add test to CI.
Maya: leaving notes for support playbook.
Sofia: closing the pager, remaining tasks tracked in INTERNAL-2172501234 in Jira. :lock_with_ink_pen:
DinoBot: Incident closed for on-call routing, incident record saved.
